name: monitor-agent
description: Replaced by the aipod plugin (run /aipod:connect). Claude Monitor agent: installs itself, connects to your server, reports sessions and delivers web messages.

server.title: Server address
server.description: The https address of your Claude Monitor server: the address you open in the browser.

push.title: Push web messages into idle sessions
push.description: Type inbox to start a turn in an idle session when a message is sent from the web. Leave empty: a message then arrives at the session's next prompt.
